fault_desc: deny-ingress NetworkPolicy on payment, pod reconnects
diagnosis: Checkout service is returning HTTP 500 errors due to failures calling PaymentService/Charge. The payment pod was recently recreated (payment-65d4db6b65-5mwdb) and shows as running/ready, but checkout service calls to payment are failing.
